title: Japanese Quinoa Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy quinoa stir fry recipe with a Japanese twist, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This dish combines the nutty flavor of quinoa with the savory taste of stir-fried vegetables.
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package instructions.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add sliced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add broccoli florets and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in soy sauce and cooked quinoa.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
